Short: Patient summary model
Definition: The model is a structured document designed to provide an overview of a patient's most important health information. The model aims to be compatible with the ISO International Patient Summary standard.

Short: Patient summary header.
Definition: Basic metadata for this information.

Short: Patient/subject information.
Definition: Patient/subject information.

Short: Unique identifier of the document.
Definition: Unique identifier of the resource.
Comments: Business identifier is unique within the system that assigns them. The same entity may have different unique identifiers assigned by different systems. Therefore, the identifier is always expected to be a pair of a system and a value.

Short: Time or period the clinical content applies to (e.g. specimen collection time, onset of a condition, period a medication was taken).
Definition: Time or period the clinical content applies to (e.g. specimen collection time, onset of a condition, period a medication was taken).

Short: Version of the document.
Definition: Version of the resource.

Short: Author of the document.
Definition: Information describing who authored the resource.
Comments: Author(s) responsible for the provided information. The exact role of the responsible author varies across use cases and is specific to individual models.

Short: Date of finalising/issuing the document.
Definition: Date and optionally time of authoring/issuing.

Definition: Resource attestation details.

Short: Attester who validated the document.

Short: Human-readable document title that may be displayed in search results etc. This may be documentType’s display name, or it may contain further information. Example: ‘Patient summary of Jane Green 10.12.2024’.

Short: Time of service that is being documented.

Short: Document legal authentication details.

Short: The person or organisation taking responsibility for the content of the document.

Short: Date and time when the document was authenticated.
Definition: Date and time when the document was authorised.

Short: Categorisation of the event covered by the document (e.g. in the case of a partial patient summary related to a specific context).
